decisions.reason: The award-winning high-pressure geothermal probe has demonstrated market success and aligns with the firm's established offer, making discontinuation very unlikely.
As part of the geothermal product family, it leverages existing expertise and shows no negative signals.
The surface technology line with several models complements the geothermal probes and likely serves customer needs, though slightly higher uncertainty.
Fire-protection steel profiles are close to the core building systems and address safety requirements, so low drop probability.
Slim steel profiles align with modern construction trends and existing steel tube capabilities, so keep.
Decorative steel profile surfaces may be more niche but still build on established offer and could differentiate the portfolio.
